searchText: So I don't think the proposer lookahead can change if the switch to compounding issue is fixed though. from my analysis I did so far that seems true but <@688748669268132001> should probably chime in in any case, the whole construction seems really fragile to me, the fact that this edge case exists is concerning with 4 epochs of missing blocks it does change of course the construction of what? the GENESIS_SLOT special casing for the consolidation request? if that's the statement then I agree with you, probably this was added to help motivate people to switch to compounding I mean that you have `payload_states` and `block_states` that coexist for the same block root and can diverge when running `process_epoch` so `dependent_root` can be unchanged but actually the state is different, the impact right now seems to only affect `proposer_lookahead` (not shuffling) but still I have the same feeling. This complexity can easily be a source of bugs. I believe, even if "it seems fine for almost all cases" we should add explicit tests to ensure all clients will use the same state the reason is we don't want to have edgecases that can become less edgy in future forks dependent_root is the problem here though which is not part of consensus it can easily be the hash or the block_root, or root + bool but the actual dependent root is that combination I don't think there's any problem with having two different states that advanced to the next epoch are divergent, they are already divergent before we advance that's the whole point of ePBS I think the problem is not on consensus, rather on the API, for all of these "issues" yep. but maybe an additional check in reference tests to verify the actual computed committees, or the state hash used to compute them.. something like that yeah we need to add a *ton* of tests with a full epoch worth of missing blocks and this very particular case of the switch to compounding validator happening in the last payload it really look like a good work for fuzzers Just a random idea, we could mixin the payload status in the dependant root, but i dont know recall RN if clients need a proper reference to a block Or it could be the executionBlockHash <:crazycry:932693133546889216> That's my proposal in some other thread, either use hash or root,bool. Either way, the "issues" we have aren't consensus issues, are API issues. And as such should be solved at that level IMO rather than trying to change consensus at this stage
